# Internship and Graduate Trainee Cohorts

## Run a 12-week trainee cohort in one organized workspace

Give interns and graduate trainees a clear place to find cohort updates, ask questions, join live conversations and access shared learning materials. Use Zedu channels to keep each discussion in context, with mentors and programme leads supporting the cohort along the way.

**Start free** � **Talk to sales**

## Give every part of the programme a place

A 12-week programme creates a steady stream of announcements, questions, live sessions and resources. Zedu brings cohort communication into organized channels, with threaded replies, announcements and file sharing. Mentors can start a quick voice conversation with Buzz inside a channel; the session summary is generated when the conversation ends.

- **Keep cohort conversations together.** Organize channels by cohort, topic or week so trainees know where to ask and follow up.
- **Make updates easy to find.** Post programme announcements in a dedicated channel and keep replies attached to the right discussion.
- **Keep materials with the conversation.** Share programme documents and resources in channels where trainees can find their context.
- **Make room for quick mentor conversations.** Start a Buzz voice discussion from a learning channel and use its generated summary as a recap.

## A sample 12-week workspace

This is a suggested channel plan to adapt to your programme. It is not a prebuilt Zedu template.

| Channel | Use |
|---|---|
| `#start-here` | Pinned welcome, programme dates, how to ask for help and where to find resources. |
| `#announcements` | Programme lead posts schedule changes and cohort-wide updates. |
| `#week-01` to `#week-12` | One channel per week for that week's materials, questions, discussions and check-ins. Name each channel with the actual weekly focus. |
| `#mentor-help` | Trainees ask questions; mentors reply in threads so answers stay together. |
| `#final-project` | Share project briefs, resources and discussion for the final project. |

**Suggested programme roles**

- **Programme lead:** maintains the schedule, posts announcements and coordinates mentors.
- **Mentors:** answer questions, guide discussions and host Buzz conversations.
- **Trainees:** follow updates, ask questions and share work or resources.

Zedu describes role-based access control, including control over who can post, announce, moderate or host sessions. Confirm the exact role and permission setup available for your account before inviting trainees.

### Pinned welcome message (sample)

> Welcome to the **[programme name]** cohort. This workspace is where you'll find programme updates, weekly materials and cohort conversations. Start with the relevant `#week-XX` channel, check `#announcements` for updates, and ask questions in `#mentor-help` so a mentor can reply in context. For a live voice discussion, your mentor may start a Buzz in the relevant channel. Please keep sensitive personal or company information out of shared channels. Your programme lead will post the schedule and any changes here.

## Five questions HR and L&D teams may ask

**1. Is Zedu a dedicated HR or internship management system?**  
Zedu's public pages describe a learning and cohort communication workspace, not HRIS features such as hiring, payroll or employee-performance tracking. Use it for cohort communication and learning materials; keep HR records in your existing approved systems.

**2. Can we control who sees or posts in each space?**  
Zedu describes private cohorts and role-based access controls for actions such as posting, moderating and hosting sessions. Confirm the precise permissions and account setup you need before sharing internal information.

**3. Does Zedu meet our data-protection requirements?**  
Zedu's privacy policy describes administrative, technical and physical safeguards, and also says no method can be guaranteed completely secure. Review the policy with your data-protection contact and avoid posting sensitive employee information unless your organization has approved that use.

**4. Will the workspace automatically track trainee attendance or performance?**  
The public product pages do not promise attendance tracking or HR performance reports. Treat the sample channels as a way to organize communication and materials, and confirm any reporting needs with Zedu before making a decision.

**5. Can it connect to our existing tools, and what will it cost?**  
Zedu's pricing page lists custom integrations for Enterprise, but does not name specific HR or LMS systems. The page currently lists a free Starter plan with up to three cohorts and a Pro plan; confirm current plan names, limits, integrations and pricing with sales before committing.
